channel.title: Delta Signal ATLAS-7 Changelog
channel.description: Public changelog for Delta Signal ATLAS-7 MCP, OpenAPI, x402, notification, SPECTRA, and evidence-contract changes.

item.title: ATLAS-7 ticker canonicalization audit
item.description: The 215-row ATLAS-7 universe was audited against the SEC company tickers exchange reference and repaired where the current common-stock ticker was unambiguous. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > ATLAS-7 ticker canonicalization audit Track: T+506m Commit: c49e722c

item.title: Notification evidence digest and ATLAS-7 universe filtering
item.description: Notification summaries now expose the daily evidence workload behind an alert and filter latest-change notification selection to the ATLAS-7 universe. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Notification evidence digest and ATLAS-7 universe filtering Track: T+498m Commit: f3410ac3 / c49e722c

item.title: Live ATLAS-history SPECTRA primary rollout
item.description: /v1/spectra-field-map/{ticker_or_cik} now prefers runtime SPECTRA generation from ATLAS-7 history over static contracts. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Live ATLAS-history SPECTRA primary rollout Track: T+490m Commit: 8d7171e

item.title: Terminal broker envelope contract
item.description: GET /v1/contract/fields now publishes the terminal MCP-brokered ATLAS envelope contract. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Terminal broker envelope contract Track: T+482m Commit: a62f4c5

item.title: Parser field contract hardened
item.description: Production now returns the versioned parser-stable field set published by GET /v1/contract/fields. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Parser field contract hardened Track: T+474m Commit: f64dc87

item.title: MCP wallet-signed grant execution verified
item.description: Production MCP now honors wallet-signed grant context accepted by the outer x402/payment wrapper before API-key enforcement. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > MCP wallet-signed grant execution verified Track: T+466m Commit: e3e4763

item.title: Wallet-signed grant auth for zero-balance clients
item.description: Added a signed wallet-grant path before x402 payment middleware so enrolled EVM wallets can prove grant identity without requiring a funded x402 payment preflight. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Wallet-signed grant auth for zero-balance clients Track: T+458m Commit: c001f26

item.title: Verified wallet grant settlement bypass
item.description: Added source support for DB-backed verified-wallet grants: x402 verifies the signed payer wallet, matches it to the promo grant ledger, consumes the DB grant counter, returns a zero-amount grant settlement response, and skips paid settlement. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Verified wallet grant settlement bypass Track: T+450m

item.title: Local regression smoke verified
item.description: Added an opt-in live-loop regression smoke for the live-loop route set and verified it locally against an internal-key gateway profile before production redeploy. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Local regression smoke verified Track: T+442m

item.title: Audit status, Morning Brief context, and public MCP discovery
item.description: Added the Azure-native ATLAS-7 audit status surface: GET /v1/atlas7/audit/latest and MCP deltasignal_atlas7_audit_status . Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Audit status, Morning Brief context, and public MCP discovery Track: T+242m

item.title: Historical source dates, SPECTRA, and ATLAS-7 calculation history
item.description: Added historical source_date support for company fundamentals, covenant stress, peer ranking, alpha signals, and the MCP company-report flow. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Historical source dates, SPECTRA, and ATLAS-7 calculation history Track: T+234m

item.title: StrategiX Visual MCP and finished DeltaSignal deliverables
item.description: Published the public StrategiX Visual MCP discovery surface for evidence-to-visual artifact workflows. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > StrategiX Visual MCP and finished DeltaSignal deliverables Track: T+226m

item.description: Added live REST/x402 routes: GET /v1/company-report/{ticker} and POST /v1/bundles/company-report . Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > Company Report became a true OpenAPI-visible aggregate Track: T+218m
